english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for acting on someone’s behalf, representing a political group, standing for something, or being an example of it.

examples.english: They represent us in talks with the principal.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 doi6 biu2 ngo5 dei6 tung4 haau6 zoeng2 king1

english.note: Use this when a sign, symbol, abbreviation, or label stands for something else.

examples.english: This abbreviation can denote Hong Kong.
examples.jyutping: nei1 go3 suk1 se2 doi6 biu2 hoeng1 gong2
